title: Individual buildings · experimental inspection
description: Individual building footprints or roofprints, including residential buildings when present in the source. All building features remain visible; use classifications are shown only where supplied.

discovery.strategy: Read the STAC latest release, validate the release identifier, use the documented public S3 PMTiles URL, and validate PMTiles header/metadata source-layer building before rendering. Keep all themes on one release. Fall back only to the dated verified release while it remains available; otherwise show a service error, never a no-buildings claim.

pinned.expiration_source: S3 x-amz-expiration response header: release data 60 day retention

classification.label: Residential tag supplied
classification.rule: Use subtype == residential, or an explicitly residential class from residential_classes if subtype is absent. Display source class and subtype verbatim. A residential subtype may include ancillary buildings such as garages; it is not a claim of occupancy.
classification.unknown_rule: Do not infer use from shape, neighborhood, size, or neighboring buildings.

properties.@geometry_source: Source of footprint geometry, when supplied
properties.sources: Source lineage encoded as a JSON string in these vector tiles

limitations: External inspection tiles are not a production basemap. Overture does not guarantee availability, performance, or stable layers/properties/zoom levels.
Hosted tile releases have a finite retention period; this view discovers and validates a current release.
Missing features, missing tags, and load failures are distinct. An empty or unavailable tile does not establish that an area has no buildings.
Footprints may instead be roof outlines traced from imagery; geometry and completeness vary by source.
Buildings are contemporary source observations, not a reconstruction of November 2006–2025.
Native tiles stop at zoom 14. Higher display zoom enlarges the available geometry without increasing its source accuracy.
These are public environmental/context data, not a movement clearance, route, bridge load rating, occupancy assessment, water safety claim, or calibrated vehicle suitability score.
